content.value_statement: Release teams often spend hours turning technical commits into customer-ready updates. This skill groups commit history and drafts clear changelogs for releases, weekly summaries, and product announcements.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes git commits from a date range, version range, or recent release window.
Groups changes into features, improvements, bug fixes, breaking changes, and security updates.
Rewrites technical commit messages into customer-facing release note language.
Formats changelog sections as clean Markdown release notes.
Filters internal maintenance, tests, and refactoring from user-facing updates.
Applies provided changelog style guidance when a user references a style file.
limitations: It depends on available commit history and commit message quality.
It may need user review before public release.
It does not publish releases or push changelog files by itself.
Large histories may require narrower date ranges or version ranges.

use_cases.title: Prepare customer release notes
use_cases.description: Create clear updates for launches, weekly releases, and feature announcements.

use_cases.title: Maintain public changelogs
use_cases.description: Turn tagged commits into readable entries for CHANGELOG.md and GitHub releases.

use_cases.title: Draft product update summaries
use_cases.description: Convert weekly engineering changes into updates for newsletters or support teams.

prompt_templates.title: Create a recent changelog
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner wants release notes from current work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a changelog from commits since the last release. Group changes by user impact and keep the wording simple.

prompt_templates.title: Use a date range
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs updates for a specific release window.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a changelog for commits between March 1 and March 15. Separate features, improvements, fixes, and breaking changes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare version release notes
prompt_templates.scenario: A maintainer is publishing a named version.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create release notes for version 2.5.0 from commits since v2.4.0. Highlight customer impact and migration notes.

prompt_templates.title: Apply custom style rules
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user has project-specific changelog rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a changelog for commits since v2.4.0 using CHANGELOG_STYLE.md. Exclude internal maintenance and flag unclear commits for review.

output_examples.input: Create a changelog for commits from the past week.
output: New Features: Team workspaces help users organize projects and invite collaborators.
Improvements: Search now includes file contents, not only titles.
Fixes: Image uploads now handle large files reliably.
Version 2.5.0 adds saved filters for faster list review.
It improves sync speed and reduces duplicate notifications.
It fixes timezone handling in scheduled posts.

output_examples.input: Summarize commits for an app store update.
output_examples.output: This update improves upload reliability, adds keyboard shortcuts, and makes search results easier to find.

best_practices: Run the request from the repository root or provide the relevant commit list.
Set a date range or version range before generating long release notes.
Review the draft for product accuracy, tone, and missing customer impact.
anti_patterns: Publishing generated notes without human review.
Asking for an entire repository history when only one release is needed.
Using unclear commit messages without adding product context.

faq.question: Does this skill run git commands?
faq.answer: It guides the assistant to analyze git history available in the working repository or supplied by the user.

faq.question: Can it write a CHANGELOG.md file?
faq.answer: It can draft content for a changelog. File writing depends on the host tool and user permissions.

faq.question: What commit ranges work best?
faq.answer: Use a version range, date range, or recent release window. Narrow ranges produce clearer output.

faq.question: Can it match my brand voice?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide changelog guidelines or examples so the draft follows your style.

faq.question: Will it include internal commits?
faq.answer: It tries to filter tests, refactors, and maintenance unless they affect users.

faq.question: Which tools support it?
faq.answer: The marketplace entry lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
